complexity.notes: Popping an arbitrary seed and expanding both ways avoids the usual `x-1 not in numset` start-of-run check; because each element is removed upon processing, total work stays linear. Clean and idiomatic.
complexity.summary: Builds a set of the numbers, then repeatedly pops an arbitrary element and expands outward in both directions, removing each consecutive element as it goes so every element is processed exactly once.
